response.justification: Bogdan brings deep, broad hands-on engineering experience (15+ years across web, backend, embedded, high-throughput microservices), a genuine open-source track record, Linux familiarity, and a completed CS degree — all relevant to the technical side of the role. However, the position is an executive-level leadership role and the resume shows no formal people-leadership, team-lead, or delivery/project-management responsibility, no explicit IT-architecture or UML/modeling practice, no client-facing consulting or requirements/compliance work, and no Python. Most critically, German is listed as 'Basic' against a hard C1 requirement for a consulting role advising German clients. Strong senior IC profile, but a poor match for a Head of Development mandate as specified.
strengths: Very broad, deep senior engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Strong open-source ownership (GISCollective, D-lang tooling) plus Linux/DevOps exposure
Proven knowledge-sharing: workshops, conference talks, courses — mentoring potential
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying
No formal leadership, team-management, or project-management track record
Little evidence of IT architecture, UML modeling, requirements mgmt, or IT security/compliance

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership / project management experience
Extensive senior engineering and open-source/Linux depth
